raw_title: More Inclusive, Less Attentive: How Digital Intermediaries Expand News Audiences but Facilitate Inequalities in News Attentiveness
title_en: More Inclusive, Less Attentive: How Digital Intermediaries Expand News Audiences but Facilitate Inequalities in News Attentiveness

plain_summary_en: This paper studies More Inclusive, Less Attentive: How Digital Intermediaries Expand News Audiences but Facilitate Inequalities in News Attentiveness. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Inequality, Intermediary, Journalism, Digital media. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
